pages.title: HomeFoodPro — Order Homemade Persian Food Online
pages.text: HomeFoodPro — Order Homemade Persian Food Online. We are a cloud kitchen in Mashhad cooking authentic Persian home food daily, delivered warm to your door. Browse the menu, order online, and track your delivery in real time. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 11:00 to 22:30. Closed on Mondays. Minimum order 150,000 Toman. Delivery is free inside Mashhad for orders over 400,000 Toman, otherwise 25,000 Toman. You can reach us at +98 51 3000 1234 or on Instagram @homefoodpro.

pages.title: Menu — HomeFoodPro
pages.text: Main dishes. Ghormeh Sabzi — 185,000 Toman including delivery. A classic herb stew with red kidney beans and tender beef, slow-cooked for four hours, served with saffron rice. Fesenjan — 210,000 Toman. Chicken simmered in a rich pomegranate and walnut sauce, sweet and sour, served with saffron rice. Zereshk Polo with Chicken — 175,000 Toman. Barberry rice with saffron chicken. Khoresh Gheymeh — 165,000 Toman. Split-pea beef stew with fried potatoes and lime. Adas Polo — 145,000 Toman. Lentil rice with raisins and dates, vegetarian. Soups and starters. Asheh Reshteh — 95,000 Toman. Noodle and herb soup with whey. Mirza Ghasemi — 110,000 Toman. Smoked aubergine with eggs and tomato, vegetarian. Bread and sides. Sangak bread — 45,000 Toman. Sabzi khordan (fresh herb platter) — 35,000 Toman. Doogh (yogurt drink) — 30,000 Toman. All prices include delivery inside Mashhad.

pages.title: Hours and Delivery — HomeFoodPro
pages.text: Kitchen hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 11:00 to 22:30. Closed every Monday. Last order is taken 45 minutes before closing. Delivery area: all of Mashhad, plus Ferdowsi and Shandiz for orders above 600,000 Toman. Average delivery time is 35 to 50 minutes depending on traffic. Orders above 400,000 Toman ship free; below that the delivery fee is 25,000 Toman. Catering for events and offices is available for groups of 10 or more with 24 hours notice — please leave your phone number and the owner will call you back with a quote. We do not deliver outside Mashhad.

pages.title: Contact and Allergens — HomeFoodPro
pages.text: Contact us: phone +98 51 3000 1234, Instagram @homefoodpro, email hello@homefoodpro.ir. Allergen policy: our kitchen handles gluten, dairy, eggs, nuts including walnuts and pistachios, and sesame. We cannot guarantee a fully allergen-free environment. The Adas Polo and Mirza Ghasemi are vegetarian; Ghormeh Sabzi, Fesenjan, Gheymeh and Zereshk Polo contain beef or chicken. If someone in your party has a serious allergy, please tell us in the order notes and we will flag it to the chef, but we cannot promise a contamination-free meal. Payments: cash on delivery, card on delivery, and online payment by Shaparak at checkout. We do not accept crypto or international cards.
